compositing_note: Each page is now generated as TWO separate simple images (letter_prompt, object_prompt) instead of one composite split-panel image -- free image APIs could not reliably follow a single-shot 'two panels + divider + badge' instruction (see generate-book-images run history). The split-panel layout itself is assembled in code by scripts/compose_split_panel.py during the assets/raw -> assets/final promotion step.
